name: soda-mpc
description: SODA MPC committee (prior work, moved in from github.com/derek2403/frontier): two Lindell '17 2-of-2 ECDSA nodes, the coordinator, the SigRequested subscriber and the EthTxRequested relayer.

scripts.test: npm test -w mpc-node && npm test -w mpc-relayer
scripts.dkg: mkdir -p node/shares && npm run dkg -w mpc-node -- shares/share-p1.json shares/share-p2.json
scripts.node:p1: MPC_ROLE=p1 PORT=8001 MPC_SHARE_PATH=shares/share-p1.json npm start -w mpc-node
scripts.node:p2: MPC_ROLE=p2 PORT=8002 MPC_SHARE_PATH=shares/share-p2.json npm start -w mpc-node
